phase: P0 baseline reproduction and retrospective diagnosis
calibration: signed max(lower-y,y-upper) score; ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic per lead; signed shrinkage permitted; crossed intervals collapse to raw midpoint; physical support [0,1]
availability: complete valid label day with target_end <= issue time; rolling excludes target_end <= issue time minus 84 calendar days; no current/future label used
refit_scope: two fixed training/prediction reproducibility witnesses, not multi-seed effectiveness evidence; replay all 17 frozen forests
raw_data_checks: reconstruct from shared read-only CSVs; compare labels/history/origins/validity/calendar/features and train-only imputer with copied caches
groups: overall, lead 1..24, month YYYY-MM, season, power [0,.01]/(.01,.2]/(.2,.8]/(.8,1], hourly up/down ramps > .1 capacity including h1 vs last observed power; groups use observed targets only for retrospective diagnosis
metrics: coverage,width,interval_score,lower/upper misses; raw seven-quantile pinball; three-level WIS with fixed raw median; median MAE vs persistence; daily simultaneous coverage descriptive only
uncertainty: synchronous paired circular moving 14-day blocks, 1000 bootstrap draws, seed 20261107, farm-macro per dataset; conditional on fitted models
historical_status: ALL dates are previously inspected retrospective/development evidence, not fresh holdouts
selection: no new hyperparameter or calibration window search; preserve all arms and failures
release: source + aggregate metrics + manifests + audit; raw data, predictions and weights remain local
